note_excerpts.text: Patient [[PATIENT_NAME_1]] seen for plaque psoriasis of the scalp. A separately identifiable evaluation was performed, after which a tangential biopsy of a 0.8 cm lesion was taken for histology.

narrative: We request reconsideration of the denial of claim [[CLAIM_ID_1]] for services rendered on [[DATE_1]]. The denied service (CPT 11102) was medically necessary and is supported by the attached note dated [[DATE_1]], and precertification reference AUTH-5521 was obtained before the visit, so CARC 197 does not apply.
